data.name: Pearle
data.long_meaning: The name Pearle is derived from the English word 'pearl', which symbolizes purity, beauty, and rarity. Pearls are formed in oysters from tiny grains of sand, which undergo a process of transformation and become precious gems. In Christianity, pearls are used as a symbol of the kingdom of heaven, which is compared to a pearl of great price in the Bible (Matthew 13:46).
